text_block_list.text:
—Happy New Year. Sweeping aside the traditional Japanese atmosphere,
the Top Star made her grand entrance.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Trainer-kun!
Yet another new year has arrived upon us."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It seems you were drawn in by my beauty.
Ah... Happy New Overlord...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Mochi! Sounds good.
Let's eat.
After eating mochi together—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, having debuted last year,
I did manage to make a decent splash, but—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Still, even now, all the world ever talks about
is the generation right above ours."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
First it was Grass-kun composing tanka,
then it was Sky-kun playing with cats...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
This year, I'm in the Classic Class too. Which means
once spring passes, I'll be in a position to race against them.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If a new star pushes them aside
and becomes the soloist...
the entire cast list will surely be turned upside down.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, my dear Trainer. Let's make this year
the start of a generational shift!

Even if she fools around on the surface,
our goal is naturally the same.

To make TM Opera O the strongest "Overlord of the Century's End."
To achieve that, clashing with the generation above her is an inevitable trial.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That said, they really are strong.
Half-hearted preparation might lead to serious trouble.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To bring about a changing of the guard, right from the start of the new year
I've got to do something on a grand scale, befitting an "Overlord."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, I ask of you, Trainer-kun!
My brilliant barber!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What grand deed would befit an "Overlord"?!
I shall indulge in it this New Year's.

Something befitting an "Overlord"...
What comes to mind is...
choice_data_list: A soothing rose bath in the tower pavilion
Listen to the voices of the public and broaden your horizons.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Isekai reincarnation! I see, I do not quite understand,
but it certainly has a ring befitting a "Conqueror"!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I have never done it, but let us imagine.
A top opera star gets involved in an accident, and ends up in another world!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oho, where am I? Who am I? Could it be... I've been reincarnated into an unfamiliar world?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"And this power surging through my body...
Oh, by reincarnating—I've become the Overlord!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hm, even if the "Overlord" becomes the "Supreme Overlord,"
I don't feel like much will change, though...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Well, whatever. A change of scenery brings a change of mood!
Ah-hah-hah-hah!"

Since she was already so strong to begin with, there wasn't a dramatic change.
Still, it felt like she had gained just a bit more power.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see! A bath with a scenic view!
Truly a New Year's event fit for the "Overlord"!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let us commence at once.
Shall we take to the stage above the clouds?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahaha! A rose bath while gazing down
at the mortal world from the rooftop. The ultimate relaxation.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Look at that mountain of plastic bags piled up in the schoolyard!
The garbage looks like garbage!
T.M. Opera O thoroughly enjoyed a refreshing bath and seemed to feel much better.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: The voice of the public, is it...? I see, listening to such things with style only adds to my own beauty.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A wonderful proposal. Then let us open it!
'New Year! The Top Star's Life Counseling Booth'!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Um, Opera O-san. I've been wondering if I should try becoming a stage actor myself, but...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Being a stage actor isn't something you aim to be.
It's something you already are."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to think! People will only follow
those who lose themselves in the moment as they are!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Opera O-san!
My New Year's gift money isn't enough!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
At the family reunion, you shall dance,
you shall sing, and you shall sign autographs for everyone!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Paper-wrapped coins shall flutter and rain down in dazzling light!
As long as one has the passion to perform, anything is possible!
Even though they're just speaking their mind freely, they're surprisingly on point... Hearing all their different worries seems to have broadened my perspective on the world.
